entities.name: PMID:25928745
observations: Compared latex transcriptomes of CATAS8-79 and PR107, clones differing in latex regeneration and flow duration; identified 6,726 differentially expressed unigenes.

Proposed ethylene, laticifer-wall lignin, antioxidants, glucanases, and rubber-particle aggregation as flow-duration candidates; jasmonates, carbohydrate metabolism, HMGR and HRT were linked mainly to regeneration. These are candidate mechanisms, not causal validation.

entities.name: PMID:26985821
observations: Ethephon increased latex-flow duration and reduced plugging index; microarray profiling at 8, 24, and 48 hours found 163 changed genes and implicated water circulation, redox, sugar metabolism, and actin dynamics.

entities.name: Sustained latex flow candidates
observations: Comparative transcriptomics has identified candidate sustained-flow mechanisms in Hevea brasiliensis: water/ethylene responses, redox and thiol buffering, carbohydrate supply, cell-wall properties, and reduced coagulation; direct comparative evidence is limited and not causal.
